Points that matter in practice

1. Same incident, several clocks. A breach at a Portuguese bank can trigger DORA (financial supervisor, 4h/24h), GDPR (CNPD, 72h) and, for important/essential classification, the RJC officer and contact-point duties. Reg. 756/2026 Art. 10(2)-(3) routes DORA incident reports to the financial supervisors but keeps the RJC registration duties. Plan a single triage with parallel clocks. 2. "Awareness" means different things. DORA counts 4h from *classification* (capped at 24h from awareness). PT RJC counts 24h from the moment the entity *concludes* there is or may be a significant incident. GDPR and NIS2 count from awareness. AI Act Art. 73 counts from awareness but requires reporting "immediately" once causality is established. 3. The PT final report differs from NIS2. It is due 30 *business* days after the end-of-impact notification, not one month after the 72h notification. PT also adds a mandatory end-of-impact notification. Incidents resolved within 2h of detection need only that notice (RJC Art. 41(2)). 4. CRA reporting is already live (since 2026-09-11) for products already on the market, even though most CRA duties apply from 2027-12-11. Micro/small manufacturers cannot be fined for a missed 24h early warning (Art. 64(10)(a)). 5. PSD2 Art. 96 is now residual. It applies only to PSPs outside DORA (Art. 96(7)). Most PSPs report under DORA from 2025-01-17. The EBA PSD2 incident guidelines remain relevant only for non-DORA PSPs [verify current EBA status]. 6. Telecoms. Personal data breaches still follow Reg. 611/2013 (24h). Network security incidents now fall under NIS2 / RJC, with ANACOM as sectoral authority (see DL 125/2025 transitional rules, Art. 8(3) and Art. 10(1)).

7. Recommendations

1. Treat the local library as the master and the Drive as a read-only mirror: 2,358 of 2,386 Drive files already exist locally. Do not re-import Drive files in bulk. 2. Pull the unique user-authored documents (Volume II handbooks, BoK Block 01, Persona Part 1, Templates Library index) into GRC-Library/_sources/ or a _user/ area so the local library is complete; keep the Google Doc versions as the editable originals. 3. Collapse the shortcut layer: 3,066 shortcuts (907 titles repeated across folders) make search noisy. Keep one canonical location per file and use the inventory CSV (or the local catalog) for cross-topic views. 4. Keep one format per stem on Drive (PDF for reading, DOCX/XMIND only where editing is needed); 1,405 files have same-stem siblings. 5. Align folder taxonomy: Drive uses 21 Portuguese thematic folders while the library uses 17 numbered domains and catalog IDs. Add a small mapping table (Drive folder → library domain) to _tools/ rather than renaming either side. 6. Move superseded trackers (00_INDEX v1/v2) and duplicate taxonomy files (.docx v1, .docx v2, .md) to 99_Archive; keep 00_TAXONOMIA … .md as the single source. 7. Move personal/non-GRC items (recipe, vcard, complaint form, skill-bundle shares, Manus/Claude exports) out of GRC Specialist Biblioteca and My Drive root to a private folder; two Claude repository exports (≈64 MB each) contain internal/confidential material per the setup guide and should stay private. 8. Fill catalog gaps from official sources (section 6.1) — especially the DORA RTS/ITS set, NIS2-IR 2024/2690, DL 125/2025 and EBA/ESA guidelines — directly into <domain>/<ID>/01-official/, not via Drive. 9. Consider the catalog additions in 6.2; insider-threat, metrics (800-55), ERM (IR 8286) and KSA PDPL already have material on Drive.

8. Limitations

  • The Drive search API returned incomplete results for OR'd folder queries and failed on some page tokens; the inventory combines a full recency-ordered listing (5,400 items to 2026-08-22T19:06Z) with date-window searches for older items. Items modified before 2023 that were not surfaced by those queries may be missing (the ISO27k toolkit files from 2021-2022 are included).
  • The two shared Claude Skills Ultimate Bundle sub-folders (third-party skill packs, ~2,000 files) were not enumerated.
  • Not readable via the connector (binary/zip/octet-stream, not downloaded by design): MCP grc — server.py, MCP online (Cloudflare Workers) — projecto completo grc-worker, Claude-FULL-export-2026-09-08.zip, FggomesClaudeexport20260910.zip, the Manus task export and all .xmind files.
  • Framework mapping is title/folder based; 940 real files (mostly generic templates, presentations and mind maps) have no framework ID.
